Any deviation from technical specif ication can lead to summarily rejection of the bids. 11) Instruction for Material Inspection at HWPK Site: a) The supplier shall furnish the Analytical Test Certificate (issued from NABL accredited lab or govt. author ized lab) for the above parameter in respect of each supply lot. All these parameters for every supply shall confirm to technical specifications. b) The final acceptance of the material will be done only after the receipt of bulk supply at site and the mat erial supplied lot sample should meet our technical specifications at HWPK laboratory. c) Result of analysis carried out at HWPK Laboratory shall be final. d) Sampling and analysis at HWPK shall be done as per IS 252-2013 (Fourth Revision, Reaffirmed in 2018). .
